description: Confused.com provides a tool that allows users to check the UK vehicle tax status for a specific car. Users provide a UK vehicle registration number, and the tool returns the vehicle tax information. The current version of the app only supports checking vehicle tax information and does not provide insurance quotes or other comparison services.

defaultPrompt: Can you tell me if the car T112ODT is taxed?
Does the car GJ23LKO have valid tax?
When does the tax on INVALID expire?
